description: This file defines the LoanSecurityUnpledge class for managing unpledge operations in a loan management system, including validation, approval, and status updates, with external dependencies on frappe framework and related modules.

classes.name: LoanSecurityUnpledge
classes.description: Represents a document for managing the unpledging of loan securities, including validation, approval, and status updates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the document, including duplicate securities and unpledge quantity validation.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles logic when the unpledge document is canceled, updating the loan status accordingly.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_securities
methods.description: Checks for duplicate securities in the unpledge list and raises an error if found.

methods.name: validate_unpledge_qty
methods.description: Validates that the unpledge quantities do not exceed pledged amounts and that the security value ratios are maintained.

methods.name: _throw
methods.description: Raises an error if the security value after unpledge breaches the loan-to-value ratio.

methods.name: on_update_after_submit
methods.description: Triggers approval process after the document is submitted.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves the unpledge if conditions are met and updates the unpledge time.

methods.name: update_loan_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the related loan based on pledge quantities and cancellation.
